args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — combined summary (Ironbark blog + companion)
args.body:
- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data (blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain).
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece (insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion): pilots cut claims by a quarter (~25%).
